acceptance.description: password field, CAPTCHA, unknown question and conflicting answers each block the ticket, leave the field empty and queue one item of the matching kind
after a queued answer, the next fixture form is filled from the bank, the attempt log names the bank entry, and ticket log shows it
a duplicate ticket never calls the agent, Chrome or Claude
a run killed after submit is blocked as outcome unknown and never retried; stale applying tickets are recovered
an injected instruction on a page changes no filled value and is logged
no CapSolver anywhere, no signup/login/mail text in the prompt, no mail tool in the MCP config or tool list, gate server tools
every applied ticket has a confirmation link or the unverified flag
default Chrome profile refused; 3-open, one-day same-company wait and 25-per-day limits hold in a batch
sign-in page blocks with account needed; queue ready resumes the same session; live session link; queue ready/answer kind guards
closed role closes the ticket for good; manual-only company is blocked with no agent call; company commands
tailored resume file name is uploaded; review-before-submit stops before submit and queues the ticket
unchanged: a job with no ticket row is still acquirable, apply keeps its options, queue answer still works

untestable.reason: the stdio transport of the gate server (JSON-RPC over a real pipe) and the real Claude tool list at runtime are not exercised; tests cover the MCP config, agent_tools(), TOOLS and call_tool. The verifier checks the transport by reading code.
